title: NO COUNTDOWN AT THE START OF A RAID
why: His order of 2026-10-12: get rid of the 3, 2, 1, GO at the beginning, it does not feel like entering a raid. It reverses his answer 18, which shipped as v24.09. The countdown is removed completely, in DEMO and CAREER alike: the big numbers and GO over a dark scrim, the hold that froze the world and the player through it, and its beeps. A raid starts the way it did before v24.09: he can move on the first frame, the raid clock and the machines run from the first frame, and nothing is drawn over the middle of the screen. Nothing replaces it.
now: The 3, 2, 1, GO at the start of every raid and demo run is gone. You have control the moment the raid starts.
